title: RNAseq analysis of blood from influenza infected patients and healthy controls
description: Gene expression changes in the blood was studied by RNAseq Results: Strong differential host reponse after infection with influenza virus compared to healthy controls project SIG_2020 Overall design: Peripheral blood was collected from patients, RNA was isolated and sequenced.
